gates.title: Environment + mfoil baseline
gates.evidence: NACA 2412 α=2° Re=1e6 converged; cl=0.4494, cd=0.00578; quadratic tail 1.6e-2→3.7e-3→8.1e-5→8.0e-8→1.0e-11

gates.title: mfoil internals introspection
gates.evidence: docs/mfoil_internals.md: R_x partial (misses AIC/ue_m/wake) -> FD-over-A strategy; complex-step blocked (arctan2); 2 vendor bugs shimmed (ADR-0002)

gates.title: CST module — fit RMS < 0.1% chord
gates.evidence: Fit RMS 2.5e-5..9.3e-5 chords (gate 1e-3) on 4 NACA sections; FM-2 curve archived: cond(GtG) 498(n=4)->5.7e9(n=16) ~ 4^n; adversarial review clean

gates.title: Constraint rows — area to 1e-10
gates.evidence: Area row vs quadrature 2.8e-17 (gate 1e-10); review CONFIRMED+fixed lower-surface te_wedge sign bug, now pinned by independent TE-slope test (5e-6)

gates.title: Linear pre-solve + realisability
gates.evidence: Presolve closed w/ ADR-0004 semantics: inviscid-consistent realisability 0.0004 (representability), viscous model gap 0.11 logged as diagnostic; initializer ratio 0.256; review-verified no masking

gates.title: Extended Newton system
gates.evidence: Extended Newton: square system, analytic flow Jacobian + FD-over-A; joint under-relaxation; viscous-stag-preserving geometry hook; converges quadratically

gates.title: Diagnostics D1–D6
gates.evidence: D1-D6 recorder + plots, 20 tests; D-2 caught the identifiability bound; D-6 order estimator per STATS_PROTOCOL H3

gates.title: Falsifiable test — recover A*
gates.evidence: PASS + adversarially hardened: 16 free coefficients recovered to 1.1e-11 in 4 iterations (2 LE coeffs prescribed); release-and-verify: natural-transition cl/cd of recovered geometry match target to 8e-13/1e-14; QR-pivoted stations (submap cond 90; full system cond 1.6e8 per D-2 — distinct quantities, ADR-0004)

gates.title: Ablations + statistical benchmark
gates.evidence: Ablation matrix + two pre-registered panels. Station selection is the identifiability guard (err 1.08e-11 QR vs 1.43e-3 even; crossed cell with no presolve lands at 1.95e-1). Cost vs tuned nested LM: 3.1-8.1x on counted solves, 3.4-3.5x on wall-clock. NACA panel 18/18 generable; UIUC panel 83/83 converged meet accuracy (Wilson LB 0.956), composite criterion misses on iteration count. 29% of the UIUC panel excluded, systematically thinner than the converged population.

gates.title: Stage 2 design review
gates.evidence: Design review adversarially checked and AMENDED: LS89 MUR comparisons moved to Stage 3 (peak M_is 0.964-1.227 across all 7 in-repo datasets = locally transonic, outside T9's own subcritical scope — caught by the closure review); Gostelow = THE Stage 2 gate; S0-S5 ladder frozen. STAGE 1 COMPLETE.
